messages:
marta: Heads-up — nightly billing report (billing.post_usage_aggregate) produced a batch of negative 'usage_offset' rows and created credits in Stripe, but NetSuite sync is leaving orphaned credit memos. Noticed ~12 accounts so far.

samir: ugh. any quick identifiers? job id / sample customer ids?

marta: job id: billing.post_usage_aggregate/2026-03-22T03:00Z. sample rows below:
```sql
select account_id, amount, kind, created_at
from usage_offsets
where created_at >= '2026-03-22' and amount < 0
limit 5;
-- results: 1257,-12.34,credit,2026-03-22T03:01Z
--          4421,-3.00,credit,2026-03-22T03:01Z
```

marta: Stripe shows credit refunds issued and customers have invoice balance reduced, but NetSuite connector created credit_memos and then failed on apply step. those credit_memos are stuck in 'Pending' and not applied to invoices.

fin-bot: NetSuite sync job failed: payload rejected for credit_memo 10234 -> 422 Unprocessable Entity: "applyAmount must be greater than 0" (attempts: 3).

elaine: sounds like we flipped sign somewhere when computing the apply delta. Could be the new 'usage_offset' flag added last week. @samir can you check the mapper that builds NetSuite payloads?

samir: on it. quick grep shows transform at infra/billing/mapper.py line ~218 toggles sign if kind == 'offset'. I'll run a quick local dry-run against a small batch.

ops-jen: recommendation: pause NetSuite apply step for nightly sync so we don't create more orphaned credit memos. we can keep creating credit memos but not attempt apply. need +1 from finance.

marta: +1 from me. want to stop further fallout while we triage.

patrick: approved. ops-jen, can you flip the feature flag or job param?

ops-jen: yes, will set NS_SYNC_APPLY=false for tonight's window. doing it now -> :gear: done. will monitor.

samir: dry-run found sign inversion: mapper treats offsets as negative, then later code negates again. patch ready: remove double-negation, add unit test for offsets. I can open a PR in 10m.

marta: awesome. after patch and test, we'll run a backfill to reprocess the pending credit_memos (ticket FIN-423). two options: re-run apply with corrected payloads or cancel and reissue new credits. prefer reapply to preserve audit trail. thoughts?

elaine: reapply is fine if NetSuite will accept. need to confirm amounts and customer-facing records. finance team, please sign-off.

patrick: reapply ok. but please add idempotency and guard to avoid double-apply if something requeues.

marta: noted. samir will add idempotency token and we will run a single reapply job. I'll create FIN-423 and attach account list.

samir: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/782 — includes fix + unit tests + migration to add idempotency_token on payloads. deploying to staging now.

fin-bot: deploy start -> billing-service v2.14.3 to staging.

ops-jen: once staging looks green, I'll schedule a controlled deploy to prod tomorrow 04:00 UTC and run the reapply backfill after a smoke check.

marta: thanks folks. I'll DM finance ops for sign-off on reapply and update FIN-423. will close thread after reapply completes. :pray:
